images.title: Two rangoli borders
images.purpose: Set up the question 7/9 − 5/9: two borders of the same size, each in 9 equal sections, lined up so the student can compare section by section.
images.composition: Two long borders of exactly the same length stacked with a wide gap, left edges lined up, each with its name on the left, and one question line centred below.
images.exact_structure: Top border: one flat rectangular strip cut into exactly 9 equal square sections; the 7 leftmost are filled teal #0072B2 with a simple plain dot in each, the other 2 are plain. Bottom border, the same length: 9 equal square sections lined up with the top; the 5 leftmost are filled amber #E69F00 with the same plain dot, the other 4 are plain. Thin grey #6B7280 dashed vertical guide lines join matching section edges. Below, centred: one question line. Exactly 2 borders, 18 sections, 7 teal, 5 amber.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any result of the subtraction shown in numbers, or borders of different lengths
images.takeaway: Same unit: line up the sections and count the extra.
images.description: Two equal rangoli borders of 9 equal sections, 7 coloured teal on Kavya's and 5 amber on Meera's, lined up for the question 7/9 − 5/9, with no answer shown.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to follow the dashed lines and say how many teal sections have no amber section under them.

image_decisions.why: Two aligned borders in ninths make the same-unit take away visible without stating the answer.
